title: Future Juice Strawberry & Kiwi Watermelon  Shortfill 100ml E-Liquid
description: Future Juice’s Strawberry & Kiwi-Watermelon is a vibrant fusion of juicy fruits, blending the sun-ripened sweetness of Strawberry with the tangy bite of Kiwi and the refreshing taste of Watermelon. The Strawberry brings a smooth, summery depth, while Kiwi adds a hint of tartness that lifts the profile. A wave of juicy Watermelon rounds off the flavour, delivering a light yet satisfying finish. Blended at 70% VG / 30% PG, this high-VG e-liquid is designed for sub-ohm vaping, producing thick clouds and intense fruit flavour. Ideal for high-powered vape kits and sub-ohm tanks, it delivers a smooth and refreshing vape experience. As a 100ml shortfill, this nicotine-free e-liquid leaves room for two 10ml nicotine shots, allowing you to customise your strength. Adding two 18mg nic shots creates 120ml of 3mg e-liquid, while nic salt shots offer a milder throat hit compared to freebase nicotine. Future Juice is a UK-based e-liquid manufacturer dedicated to crafting premium blends with bold, layered flavours. Their shortfill range combines classic dessert and fruit-inspired profiles, designed for vapers who enjoy rich, satisfying e-liquids.
